snippet.title: Dragon Khan - Official Demo Release Date Trailer
snippet.description: Take a look at the Demo Release Date Trailer for Dragon Khan, a third-person action hack-and-slash RPG developed by Evolution Game Studio. Players will embody Botu, a blend of dragon and human, on a quest to master technical martial arts and hone in powerful magic abilities. Defend the calm lands of the Verdant Empire from calamity in Dragon Khan, coming soon to PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam), with a demo launching on January 8, 2026, on Steam.
